CS-Type Stop Ring for Shaft (CSTW)

A stop ring secured by a number of star-shaped claws (3 to 8) that bite into the outer surface of the shaft. Similar to a push nut (SPN), but with more claws arranged radially, it distributes the load more evenly. It can be installed directly without any groove machining. Its specification symbol is denoted as CSTW.
